blocks.title:
Six agents. One pipeline.
A person at every gate.
blocks.sub: This is the delivery pipeline every Hopsig build runs on. Each stage is an agent with a defined input, output and guardrail; each handoff can be stopped by a person. Hover a stage; the detail is below.

templateText: Runs on its own inside the guardrail

blocks.title: What the agents do.
rows: Plan from a plain-language brief, and show the plan before anything is built
Populate epics and stories with acceptance criteria, in your tracker
Implement a story inside your conventions, lint rules and branch policy
Generate tests for the change and run them in your CI
Review a diff and write the pull-request description
Update the documentation that the change made stale
Stop and ask a person, with the context, when a decision is outside the guardrails
Change the guardrails, the CI or the branch rules
Touch a production environment or production data
Decide scope, or add to it
Spend money, open accounts or talk to your users
Carry on when a person has said stop

blocks.title: Built on Claude Code. Runs on yours.
blocks.sub: The agents run on Claude Code with MCP servers for your tracker, your CI and your docs. Model calls go through a provider with no training on your data, or inside your own cloud account; the SOW says which. Nothing of ours to adopt.
rows: A ten-engineer practice, now its default path for new work.
Two Android apps scoped at five developers were shipped by one, on the original timeline. The same pipeline customised a Dynamics 365 environment end to end through three MCP servers.
